description.value: Pho 37 is an award-winning Vietnamese restaurant chain with its Commercial Drive location sitting on one of Vancouver's most bike-friendly corridors. The restaurant serves authentic, scratch-made pho, vermicelli bowls, and a broad menu of Vietnamese appetizers and mains — all prepared fresh daily with MSG-free ingredients. Past accolades include the Canadian Choice Award for Vietnamese Restaurant and recognition on Yelp Elites' Top Places to Eat.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: wall_loops (3 spaces) at 95m. Total: 3 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content at pho37.ca is fully accessible and confirms the Commercial Drive location at 1818 Commercial Drive with phone (604) 655-2223, corroborating the OSM address. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via 'Order To Go Pick up at our Restaurants or Get delivery by our partners.' Vegetarian options are confirmed through explicit menu labeling ('Regular / Vegetarian' spring rolls, tofu salad rolls, 'Vegetables and Tofu Noodle'). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone (604) 655-2223 sourced from website for the Commercial Drive location only.
pho37.ca is a multi-location chain site; care should be taken to link cyclists specifically to the 1818 Commercial Drive location details.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, actively operating Vietnamese restaurant on Commercial Drive — one of Vancouver's premier cycling corridors — offering sit-down dining, takeout, and vegetarian menu options that serve touring cyclists well.
